C1_adjustment_reason: C4 escape requires 0.15 mm trace plus 0.15 mm clearance on both sides; C1 downward shift opens 0.49 mm between copper pads.
C4_adjustment_reason: Creates room for a GND via with its drill outside the SMD pad and connects an otherwise isolated GND island.

GND_connectivity.method: Same-net filled zones, tracks/arcs, pad copper and via annuli are unioned on each layer; plated item identities bridge layers. Reachability starts at the named GND pad. This geometric graph does not replace KiCad connectivity/DRC or physical testing.
